grammar.pattern: description + 的 + noun · manner + 地 + verb
grammar.explanation: 的 links a description to a noun: 我的包, 认真的学生. 地 links a manner description to a verb: 认真地读. Both are neutral-tone de, but their written forms and functions differ. In natural speech simple manner words may occur without 地; do not treat every omission as wrong. 我的 can stand alone when the possessed noun is understood.

examples.zh: 这是我的课本，那是别人的。
examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de kè běn , nà shì bié ren de .
examples.en: This is my textbook; that one belongs to someone else.

examples.zh: 认真的学生认真地读课文。
examples.py: rèn zhēn de xué sheng rèn zhēn de dú kè wén .
examples.en: The careful student reads the lesson text carefully.

commonMistakes.why: The noun 课本 needs an ownership phrase with 的, not an adverbial phrase with 地.

grammar.explanation: Put an ordinary object after the verb: 找钱包, 帮我, 读今天的课文. A noun phrase can contain ownership or a description. Do not confuse the object with the subject: 我找你的书 says who searches and what they search for. Chinese can omit an already understood object in conversation; an omitted object is not automatically an error.

examples.py: wǒ zhǎo qián bāo , nǐ bāng wǒ .
examples.en: I will look for the wallet; please help me.

examples.py: tā dú jīn tiān de kè wén .

examples.zh: 朋友送我一本书，我得到一本外语课本。
examples.py: péng you sòng wǒ yī běn shū , wǒ dé dào yī běn wài yǔ kè běn .
examples.en: A friend gave me a book; I received a foreign-language textbook.

commonMistakes.why: 你的书 is one object phrase after 找.

dialogue.title: Whose bag?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find who owns the bag and what the missing item is.

lines.zh: 这是你的包吗？
lines.py: zhè shì nǐ de bāo ma ?
lines.en: Is this your bag?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，这是别人的。我的包是白的。
lines.py: bù shì , zhè shì bié ren de . wǒ de bāo shì bái de .
lines.en: No, it belongs to someone else. My bag is white.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你在找什么？
lines.py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me ?
lines.en: What are you looking for?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我找钱包，可以帮忙吗？
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo qián bāo , kě yǐ bāng máng ma ?
lines.en: I am looking for my wallet. Could you help?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我帮你找。课本也在包里吗？
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo . kè běn yě zài bāo lǐ ma ?
lines.en: Sure, I will help you look. Is your textbook in the bag too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在。外语课本很重要，今天要读课文。
lines.py: zài . wài yǔ kè běn hěn zhòng yào , jīn tiān yào dú kè wén .
lines.en: Yes. The foreign-language textbook is important; we need to read the lesson text today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我找到白包了，钱包在里边。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo dào bái bāo le , qián bāo zài lǐ bian .
lines.en: I found the white bag. The wallet is inside.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢！朋友在书店买了这本新书，我得到了一本好书，里面的知识很有用。
lines.py: xiè xiè ! péng you zài shū diàn mǎi le zhè běn xīn shū , wǒ dé dào le yī běn hǎo shū , lǐ miàn de zhī shi hěn yǒu yòng .
lines.en: Thanks! My friend bought this new book at the bookshop, and I received a good book. The knowledge inside is useful.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你学习很认真。
lines.py: nǐ xué xí hěn rèn zhēn .
lines.en: You study carefully.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想认真地读，不想只看答案。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng rèn zhēn de dú , bù xiǎng zhǐ kàn dá àn .
lines.en: I want to read carefully, not just look at answers.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个充电器也是你的吗？
lines.py: zhè gè chōng diàn qì yě shì nǐ de ma ?
lines.en: Is this charger yours too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，先问别人吧。
lines.py: bù shì , xiān wèn bié ren ba .
lines.en: No. Ask the others first.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What does one friend help the other do?

choices: Yes, it belongs to the bookshop

reading.title: Message after study
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find the lost item, its location and the unclaimed object.

lines.zh: 今天朋友去学校旁边的书店，买了外语课本送我。
lines.py: jīn tiān péng you qù xué xiào páng biān de shū diàn , mǎi le wài yǔ kè běn sòng wǒ .
lines.en: Today my friend went to the bookshop next to school and bought me a foreign-language textbook.

lines.zh: 课文里的知识很有用，对我也很重要。
lines.py: kè wén lǐ de zhī shi hěn yǒu yòng , duì wǒ yě hěn zhòng yào .
lines.en: The knowledge in the lesson text is useful and important to me.

lines.zh: 我想认真地读课文，朋友学习也很认真。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng rèn zhēn de dú kè wén , péng you xué xí yě hěn rèn zhēn .
lines.en: I want to read carefully; my friend also studies carefully.

lines.zh: 我找课本的时候，没有找到钱包。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo kè běn de shí hou , méi yǒu zhǎo dào qián bāo .
lines.en: When I looked for my textbook, I could not find my wallet.

lines.zh: 朋友来帮忙，帮我找白色的包。
lines.py: péng you lái bāng máng , bāng wǒ zhǎo bái sè de bāo .
lines.en: My friend came to help, and helped me look for the white bag.

lines.zh: 他找到包了，钱包在包里。
lines.py: tā zhǎo dào bāo le , qián bāo zài bāo lǐ .
lines.en: He found the bag; the wallet was inside.

lines.zh: 桌子上还有别人的包和一个充电器。
lines.py: zhuō zi shàng hái yǒu bié ren de bāo hé yī gè chōng diàn qì .
lines.en: On the table were someone else’s bag and a charger.

lines.zh: 我知道那个包不是我的，不知道充电器是谁的。
lines.py: wǒ zhī dào nà gè bāo bù shì wǒ de , bù zhī dào chōng diàn qì shì shéi de .
lines.en: I know that bag is not mine; I do not know whose charger it is.

lines.zh: 我先问别人，再回家。
lines.py: wǒ xiān wèn bié ren , zài huí jiā .
lines.en: I will ask the others first, then go home.

lines.py: bié zhǎo le , wǒ zhǎo dào nǐ de bāo le .

lines.py: bái de nà gè ? qián bāo yě zài ma ?

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 在。你的课本也在。
lines.py: zài . nǐ de kè běn yě zài .

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 帮大忙了，这本书很重要。
lines.py: bāng dà máng le , zhè běn shū hěn zhòng yào .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友在书店买的外语书？
lines.py: péng you zài shū diàn mǎi de wài yǔ shū ?

lines.zh: 对，课文有用，知识也有用。
lines.py: duì , kè wén yǒu yòng , zhī shi yě yǒu yòng .

lines.zh: 认真地读吧。别人的包，我们先不拿。
lines.py: rèn zhēn de dú ba . bié ren de bāo , wǒ men xiān bù ná .

lines.py: hǎo . xiè xiè nǐ bāng máng , bù zhǐ shì bāng wǒ zhǎo dōng xi .
lines.en: Okay. Thanks for helping, with more than just looking for things.

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 一20, 一26. Native check: 得到 in the bookshop context; omission of 地 in ordinary speech; charger ownership language. No blanket rule that a missing 地 is ungrammatical. Planned retrieval 一15 / 一43: 从这儿到机场远吗？, 这件衣服一百二十块。, 水三块。.
